proposed_action: Add only the U2 harness and own UTC verification memory; do not implement production behavior
strategy: Behavior assertions use already-declared U1 seams. AST and channel reflection observe U2-owned private fields without missing-symbol compilation errors, replacement schedulers or production stubs. Minimal SDK notification-session fixture is not a future U3 dispatcher.

scenario_mapping.TestU2_CoordinatorFIFOMutationOrderAndCo: SC3/R7/R8: Server source shape and classification; synchronous execution; eight FIFO admissions, overlap detection, four simultaneous readers during a held mutation, sync_index read drain
scenario_mapping.TestU2_CoordinatorQueueFullAndCallerCanc: SC4/R9: cancelled and full-32-queue busy envelopes, no partial handler execution, successor handoff, partially acquired barrier tokens returned on cancellation
scenario_mapping.TestU2_CoordinatorProgressNotificationsI: R10/D8: synchronous result with queued/started/completed caller-token notifications, no peer leakage, no-token and unsupported-session capability cases

harness_cmd: & { . ./bin/tmp/212-go-env.ps1; $ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'; $env:TEMP = Join-Path $PWD ('bin/_u2_' + [guid]::NewGuid().ToString('N').Substring(0,6)); $env:TMP = $env:TEMP; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $env:TEMP | Out-Null; $names = @('TestU2_CoordinatorFIFOMutationOrderAndConcurrentReads','TestU2_CoordinatorQueueFullAndCallerCancellationSafety','TestU2_CoordinatorProgressNotificationsIsolatedToCallerSession'); $pkg = 'github.com/softwaresalt/backlogit/internal/mcp'; $raw = @(go test ./internal/mcp -count=1 -race -timeout=30m -run '^TestU2_' -json 2>&1); $native = $LASTEXITCODE; $raw | ForEach-Object { Write-Output "$_" }; $events = @($raw | ForEach-Object { "$_" | ConvertFrom-Json }); $text = ($raw | ForEach-Object { "$_" }) -join "`n"; if ($native -notin @(0,1) -or $text -match 'no tests to run|\[no test files\]|build failed|panic:|fatal error:|WARNING: DATA RACE' -or @($events | Where-Object { $_.Action -eq 'skip' -or $_.Package -ne $pkg }).Count -ne 0) { Write-Output 'U2_NO_VACUITY=REJECTED'; exit 2 }; $top = @($events | Where-Object { $_.Test -and $_.Test -notmatch '/' -and $_.Action -eq 'run' }); if ($top.Count -ne 3) { Write-Output 'U2_NAMED_RUN_COUNT=REJECTED'; exit 2 }; foreach ($name in $names) { $run = @($events | Where-Object { $_.Test -eq $name -and $_.Action -eq 'run' }); $pass = @($events | Where-Object { $_.Test -eq $name -and $_.Action -eq 'pass' }); $fail = @($events | Where-Object { $_.Test -eq $name -and $_.Action -eq 'fail' }); if ($run.Count -ne 1 -or ($native -eq 0 -and ($pass.Count -ne 1 -or $fail.Count -ne 0)) -or ($native -eq 1 -and ($fail.Count -ne 1 -or $pass.Count -ne 0))) { Write-Output "U2_NAMED_RESULT=REJECTED:$name"; exit 2 } }; $packageEnd = @($events | Where-Object { -not $_.Test -and $_.Action -in @('pass','fail') }); if ($packageEnd.Count -ne 1 -or ($native -eq 0 -and $packageEnd[0].Action -ne 'pass') -or ($native -eq 1 -and $packageEnd[0].Action -ne 'fail')) { Write-Output 'U2_PACKAGE_RESULT=REJECTED'; exit 2 }; Write-Output "U2_NO_VACUITY=PASS NAMED_RUN=3 NAMED_PASS=$(@($events | Where-Object { $_.Test -in $names -and $_.Action -eq 'pass' }).Count) NAMED_FAIL=$(@($events | Where-Object { $_.Test -in $names -and $_.Action -eq 'fail' }).Count) GO_NATIVE_EXIT=$native"; exit $native }

named_red.TestU2_CoordinatorFIFOMutationOrderAndCo: Assertion: missing U2 Server coordinator source shape/classification; existing Execute returns ErrNotImplemented rather than synchronously executing handler
named_red.TestU2_CoordinatorQueueFullAndCallerCanc: Assertion: existing Execute returns ErrNotImplemented rather than the request_cancelled BusyErrorResponse tool envelope
named_red.TestU2_CoordinatorProgressNotificationsI: Assertion: existing Execute returns ErrNotImplemented rather than synchronous tools/call result with caller progress
